title: Output of the OParl Council Data Reader
description: One dataset of normalised OParl records (meetings, papers and the other requested collections) from a single municipal endpoint, plus one final item with _report=true carrying the measured capability fingerprint of that endpoint.

records.title: OParl records
records.description: Normalised OParl records from the requested collections. Each item keeps the vendor's original object under 'raw' and adds the fields a caller filters on: id, type, name, start, end, location, organizationIds, sourceSystem, vendor, fetchedAt. The last item is the run report (_report=true) with the endpoint's paging mode, resolved collection URLs and per-collection status, so a run that found nothing is still readable.
